title: Oven Roasted Ukrainian Yellow Pepper Stew
description: A fermented and velvety post-workout stew featuring yellow peppers, beurre-monte, and Buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients, this Ukrainian dish is perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the yellow peppers into large pieces and place them on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the peppers and roast in the oven for 30 minutes.
In a large pot, saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the pot and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the vegetable broth, tomato paste, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the roasted peppers to the pot and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the stew for 20 minutes.
Stir in the beurre-monte and serve hot.
